text: G60a (amendment, 21 October 2026, D3a-56, written after reading the first verdict page and before any verdict row is written; it applies to every ruling, and there are no earlier rulings for it to reach backwards). G60 point 4 named a paired elaboration accepted at D3 as an act the served model lacked. That is too wide. An elaboration adds a step or condition inside an element's act: a location cue in a call, a reason given in a call, an answer that asks what to do (austriahungary-007, tenma-002, NovaScotia-002, polyamory-004). The act stays the element's, so the room's organizing still restates in the model's terms. An item carries organizing the served model lacks only where its act is one that no element, arrow, candidate or tentative entry of the served model states: in D3's rulings, an act accepted as a proposal (now one of P23 to P34 or K05 to K07), or a particular that shows canvas organizing in one room. G60's reading 1, before the rows of page d3_vpage_000 (the 21 splits with a cannot-tell reader): (a) Below the concept floor, the concepts decide the claim when each can be read as an act, so that the room's coded organizing can be told whole; a single call decides that the coded organizing is a call. They do not decide it when an act cannot be read (a bare title, a lost body). (b) Where a reader says cannot-tell under off-platform because coordination moved to a chat the record does not hold, the record still decides that the organizing ran through a chat, which the served model lacks (D3a-55: P23). Where the thread shows the rest of the room's organizing in the model's terms, the restatement stands with the chat items as residue; cannot-tell holds only where the thread shows too little of the rest to restate it. (c) The ruling's residue lists items one of the readers named, as themes or concepts, and only those that pass. Items the served model holds (P06 tracing, K04 lore and politics, P20 arguing the canvas's worth, P17 shared chats between rooms, P11 credit) and items that are not canvas organizing (April Fools play, the sub's own business, a false moderator claim) do not pass. Rows: austriahungary, bannedfromanime_irl, littlebusters, NovaScotia, oltp, tenma and TheID compose (each concept restates: calls, location cues, templates, credit, taunts, a display fault P06 holds). Bravenewbies (c0005, a call into a chat to make the logo), polyamory (c0004, a chat offered; c0006, not knowing what the notification is) and Redox (c0002 and c0003, asking and explaining what the neighbouring art shows) compose with residue. azores, crusaderkings, de, paladins, reddevils, serbia, smashbros, THE_R, TransFlagPlace, trees and UNLincoln compose with residue: the chat (azores t02, de t09 and t12, reddevils t05, serbia t05, smashbros t03 and t14, TransFlagPlace t06, trees t05), explaining and asking (de t11, paladins t12, THE_R t03, UNLincoln t02 on whose logo it is), the members' time (de t07), the site (crusaderkings c0090, de t22), new jokes (trees t15), the work turned toward its developer (crusaderkings c0124), a room made for the canvas (THE_R t04, c0001). Held by the served model, so they do not pass: tracing who changed the work and why (P06: buffalowizards c0013, Clannad t06, cmu c0028, c0030), arguing over scripts (P14: aggies t09), a host's leave and a guest's request (P19: criticalrole c0050, bulgaria c0034, AmericanFlaginPlace c0115), an invitation into another room's chat (P17: bdsm t04, c0007), carried-in quarrels and ideology (K03, K04: btc t03, t08, t10; afip t06, c0004; danganronpa lore), a vote (C01: chile c0019), credit disputes (P11, P02: afip c0065 to c0073). Not canvas organizing: April Fools play and roleplay (bisexual t09, clashroyale t03, danganronpa t18, t19, t23), the sub's ordinary business (australia's T3-017 themes and poems), a joke about a player (49ers t03).
